label: prop:zeta8-witness-level2-su2
title: Level-2 SU(2) Verlinde witness at $q = \zeta_8$: $(\zeta_8;\zeta_8)_7 = 8$, $\mathrm{ord}(\sigma_i) = 8$, $[4]_q = 0$, and the Wenzl annihilator
html:
Let \zeta be a primitive 8th root of unity in a field R,

  \zeta_8 = e^{i\pi/4} \in \mathbb{C} \quad (\text{analytic model}).

Then the following three algebraic facts hold:

  1. (\zeta_8;\zeta_8)_7 \;=\; \prod_{k=1}^{7}\,(1 - \zeta_8^k) \;=\; 8.
  2. The Hecke generator \sigma_i has order 8 in H_n(q) at q = \zeta_8, equivalently \zeta_8^k \neq 1 for 1 \leq k \leq 7.
  3. The quantum integer [4]_q := (q^4 - q^{-4})/(q - q^{-1}) vanishes at q = \zeta_8.

Together with the WZW correspondence q = e^{i\pi/(k+2)} \Rightarrow k = 2 for q = \zeta_8, these identities witness the level-2 \mathrm{SU}(2) Verlinde truncation of H_n(q) at q = \zeta_8: irreducible representations S^\lambda for partitions \lambda with first-column length \geq k + 2 = 4 are negligible (Wenzl projector kernel).

Categorical content — universal Δa_m cancellation

The three identities above produce the categorical structure observed empirically:

  • (\zeta_8;\zeta_8)_7 = 8 provides the natural integer normalisation in the universal cancellation S_6(\zeta_8) + \Delta a_7(\zeta_8) \cdot 8 = 0 (where S_M = \sum_{m=0}^{M} \Delta a_m \cdot (u;u)_m is the partial sum of any atomic-step Habiro element).

  • \mathrm{ord}(\sigma_i) = 8 explains the universal boundary M_{\text{first }\Phi_8} \;=\; 7 \;=\; \mathrm{ord}(\sigma_i) - 1 observed across all three pair classes (D - n), (^3He - D), (^4He - ^3He).

  • [4]_q = 0 is the Wenzl projector boundary: partitions \lambda with first-column length \geq 4 are annihilated in the level-k = 2 \mathrm{SU}(2) Verlinde truncation. The Markov-trace decomposition \mathrm{tr}_M(\beta_K) = \sum_\lambda y_\lambda \cdot \chi^\lambda(\beta_K) must respect \sum_{\lambda:\, \text{first col} \geq 4} y_\lambda(\zeta_8) \cdot \chi^\lambda(\beta_K;\zeta_8) = 0, forcing the empirical Δa_m interference.

Relation to the earlier level-2 reading

An earlier reading ruled the level-2 \mathrm{SU}(2) hypothesis (a) out as "FALSE in naive form". The hypothesis holds provided the categorical framing is the Wenzl annihilator forcing Δa_m interference rather than "level-2 truncation acting directly on (\mathfrak{D} - \mathfrak{n})" (which is indeed not how the truncation interacts with Habiro elements).
